# Procurement by InHR

> SaaS platform to manage industrial purchase processes (PdC) end-to-end — from technical specification through quotation, awarding, FAT and logistics — with role-based workflows, traffic-light tracking and automatic alerts.

Procurement by InHR is a multi-tenant procurement management application for engineering and operations teams. Each Purchase Process (PdC) moves through an 8-stage lifecycle (Borrador → Técnica → Planificación → Cotización → Adjudicación → OC/Vendor → FAT → Logística) with role-based access (Admin, Ingeniería, Programación, Compras, Gerente, Planificación, Logística).

## Pages

- [Home / Dashboard](/): KPIs, traffic-light status of active PdCs and pending alerts.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to the platform.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new account.
- [Forgot password](/forgot-password): Request a password reset email.

## Optional

- [PdC list](/pdcs): Authenticated list of all purchase processes.
- [Alerts](/alerts): Authenticated list of active alerts.
